hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/assateague.aspx ('30-amp electric hook-ups available in the G-Loop and I-Loop only') + parkreservations.maryland.gov per-site catalog for parkId 380101 (all 43 Campsite Electric sites list Electrical Service 30 amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DNR: 342 campsites plus 3 youth group sites; the booking site lists 316 bookable campsites (43 electric in loops G and I, 273 non-electric). Listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 40-50 ft, with the electric G loop at 60-75 ft; a few G-loop sites are pull-through. ADA-only sites are reserved solely for visitors with a disability.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/assateague.aspx (Campground Specifics) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/assateague-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380101 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/assateague-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380101 (Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Showers, Restrooms, Park Store), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DNR: 'Reservations for Assateague State Park can be made up to 365 days in advance', and the booking page takes same-day reservations. Maximum stay is 14 cumulative nights in Maryland state park campgrounds in any 21-day period. Check-in 2-10 p.m.; no check-ins after 10 p.m.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/eastern/assateague.aspx (Reservations; Campground Office) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/assateague-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380101 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance'; alert 'Maximum Stay'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/365-day window for this park; season already manual. Added 30-amp electric (G and I loops only), 342 sites (316 bookable online) to 75 ft with some pull-throughs, showers, dump, park store, 14-night max. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, min stay for this park (left inherited), fcfs. Fees not changed (human-checked 2026-10-12): see flag.
flags: fees disagreement between two official pages: DNR's rate page (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/oc.aspx, read 2026-10-20) says 'Campsite: $27.50, Campsite with electric: $38.50', matching the entry, but the ReserveAmerica Facility Rates table for parkId 380101 lists Campsite Non-Electric $28.50-$29.50 (and Electric $38.50-$39.50) for both the Apr 22-Nov 1 2026 and Apr 21-Oct 31 2027 peak seasons. Greenbrier's and Cunningham Falls' tables match DNR exactly, so the Assateague non-electric line is $1 off DNR. The entry's fees were checked by a human 2026-10-12 against 2027 quotes, so they were left alone; worth a fresh quote.
